Hearing a lot of people be all ‘what a relief- no major damage was done yaaa’ about #CycloneNisarg 
We need to know that this is the first cyclone in a century #Mumbai just underwent and we need to learn from it and plan for more extreme weather events. #ClimateCrisis

This is why #ClimateCrisis is a human rights problem, a gender equality problem, a caste problem, a racial justice problem, a white supremacy problem. In the same way the #ElephantDeathCase is more than what meets the eye. We need to look, recognise and educate ourselves at depth

As an Indian Muslim, I see the use of #BlackLivesMatter by Indians not as an extension of real solidarity but as a reflection of the moral disfigurement of a population that looks the other way when its own minorities are discriminated against and lynched.
https://t.co/aS8M0YDRoi

A government that sacrifices environmental safeguards as an excuse to aid investment, is unfit to lead. It is an act of a Govt. that doesn't seem to be able to grasp the urgency of the #ClimateCrisis 
#WithdrawEIA2020 #EIAForGreenIndia @moefcc @PrakashJavdekar @PMOIndia #India
